content: Section 7.2 of the American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines highlights the importance of initiating continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) early in the management of type 1 diabetes to help patients achieve their glycemic targets effectively. Section 24 has been updated to underscore the value of insulin pens and injection aids, particularly for individuals who experience challenges with manual dexterity or visual impairments, ensuring they can administer insulin more easily and accurately. Section 33 recommends the continued use of CGM devices in hospitalized patients with diabetes, provided it is clinically appropriate, to support optimal glucose management during their hospital stay.
